infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MAGE ID uses your microphone for voice dictation — capturing daily field reports, punch-list items, and project notes hands-free on the jobsite. Audio is transcribed and discarded; nothing is recorded permanently.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MAGE ID uses your camera to capture jobsite photos for daily reports, punch-list items, RFIs, and project documentation. Photos are stored against the project they were taken on.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MAGE ID needs access to your photo library so you can attach existing photos to daily reports, punch-list items, RFIs, and project documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MAGE ID saves project photos and rendered PDFs to your photo library when you tap Save / Share.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MAGE ID stamps jobsite photos with GPS coordinates so daily-report photos and field-stamped takeoff verifications carry location proof. Location is only read when you take a photo or stamp a row — never in the background.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: MAGE ID uses Face ID to sign you back in without re-typing your password.
